in_game_description: Tiny particles that remain hidden from the naked eye that can be very useful. For example, there are nanobots that can transport medicine to certain hard-to-reach parts of the body and cure contagious diseases.
mechanics_text: Required for blueprints: 7t Icarus Heavy AS, 7t Gamma Shield II, 8t 128MJ Railgun, 25t Disruptor Laser, 65t Fluxed Matter Shield, 65t Particle Shield, 90t Gunant's Drill.
